title: Add changeset for ObjectQL 3.0.1 dependency upgrade
body:
The PR upgrading `@objectql/sdk` and `@objectql/types` from ^1.9.1 to ^3.0.1 failed changeset validation because no changeset file was included.

## Changes

- **Added changeset file** documenting the ObjectQL dependency upgrade
  - Affects: `@object-ui/data-objectql` and `@object-ui/plugin-object`
  - Version bump: `minor` (major dependency upgrade, backwards-compatible public APIs)
  - Verified: builds pass, tests pass (14/14)

## Context

Changesets are required for package modifications to maintain version control and changelog generation in the monorepo. AI-generated PRs modifying packages should include changesets describing the changes.

The changeset format:
```markdown
---
"@object-ui/data-objectql": minor
"@object-ui/plugin-object": minor
---

Upgrade ObjectQL dependencies from ^1.9.1 to ^3.0.1
```
